On 2012-Aug-14, at 20:37 , mjackman <mollyc...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> I'm having difficulty adding a legend. I would like the legend to include two items (1) a black dot next to the word "Mean", and (2) a bounded bar next to the work "95% confidence interval." Any advice on how to do this would be greatly appreciated!

This kind of thing is usually in the textual legend that accompanies the plot. But in case you need it on the plot itself I would advise to use annotate() with geom="text" to place the words "mean" and "95% CI" on the plot directly (or use Inkscape to annotate the plot a posteriori).

Jean-Olivier Irisson
